title: What my PandaDoc spec forgot: 29/29 checks passed, 8 gaps found #shorts
description:
Claude built a PandaDoc alternative, a quote builder where big discounts need a manager, from one written spec: all 29 acceptance checks passed, but my spec never said whether an approval request went through when no other manager could approve it. That was 1 of 8 spec gaps, and all 8 are now fixed (the request is now refused).

Full build test (2:40): https://youtu.be/cDWAAYw-R_Q
The free spec: https://personalsoftwarefactory.com/blueprints/quote-builder
PandaDoc pricing and alternatives: https://personalsoftwarefactory.com/alternatives/pandadoc

Not tested: real sign-in, sending email, the daily job on a real scheduler, the browser's print dialog, and hosting.

Made with AI: Sam's on-camera intro and outro are an AI avatar of him, and the narration is his AI voice clone (HeyGen). The product footage is from the real test build.
